projects.title: Contract clause assistant for a legal-tech startup
projects.problem: lawyers spent hours locating indemnity and termination clauses across 300-page vendor contracts
projects.approach: a retrieval pipeline that chunks contracts by clause heading, retrieves with hybrid search and forces every answer to quote the clause it relies on
outcomes: clause lookup time fell from ~40 minutes to under 2 minutes
answer citation accuracy of 94% on a 120-question review set
projects.review: the answers always pointed at the exact clause, which is what got our partners to trust it

projects.title: Customer-support triage agent for a SaaS helpdesk
projects.problem: first-response times above 9 hours because every ticket was triaged by hand
projects.approach: an agent that classifies intent, pulls account context through the Zendesk API and drafts a reply for a human to approve, with long-running enrichment pushed to a worker queue
outcomes: median first response dropped from 9.2 h to 47 min
63% of drafted replies sent with no edits
projects.review: drafts were good enough that our team mostly just clicked approve

projects.title: Demand forecasting service for a grocery chain
projects.problem: stock-outs on fresh produce and 11% waste from over-ordering
projects.approach: store-by-SKU gradient-boosted forecasts with holiday and weather features, retrained nightly by an Airflow DAG
outcomes: forecast MAPE improved from 31% to 18%
produce waste down 4 percentage points in the pilot region
projects.review: the weekly error report made it easy for ops to see when to trust the numbers

projects.title: Invoice extraction pipeline with vision-language models
projects.problem: an AP team keyed 2,000 supplier invoices a month by hand
projects.approach: a fine-tuned document-understanding model that outputs JSON line items, validated against purchase orders before posting
outcomes: field-level F1 of 0.93 on held-out suppliers
manual keying reduced by roughly 70%
projects.review: handled the ugly scanned invoices we were sure would break it

projects.title: Evaluation harness for an LLM writing assistant
projects.problem: prompt changes shipped weekly with no way to tell whether feedback quality got worse
projects.approach: a golden set of 400 graded essays, an LLM judge calibrated against teacher labels and a CI gate on every prompt change
outcomes: judge agreement with teachers of Cohen's kappa 0.71
caught two regressions before release in the first month
projects.review: finally we argue about numbers instead of vibes

projects.title: Semantic product search for a fashion marketplace
projects.problem: keyword search returned nothing for queries like 'summer wedding outfit under 5k'
projects.approach: hybrid lexical plus dense retrieval with a cross-encoder reranker and price filters parsed from the query
outcomes: search conversion up 17% in an A/B test
zero-result queries down from 12% to 3%
projects.review: conversion moved in the first week of the test

projects.title: Voice-notes summarizer for field sales reps
projects.problem: reps recorded visit notes as voice memos that nobody ever listened to
projects.approach: speech-to-text transcription, structured summaries pushed into the CRM and a nightly digest for managers
outcomes: CRM visit notes completion rose from 35% to 88%
average summary latency 40 seconds per memo
projects.review: our managers read the digest every morning now

projects.title: Fraud scoring model for a buy-now-pay-later lender
projects.problem: rule-based fraud checks blocked good customers and missed coordinated fraud rings
projects.approach: a gradient-boosted classifier on application and device features with SHAP reason codes for analysts and monthly drift monitoring
outcomes: fraud losses down 38% at the same approval rate
precision at 1% alert rate improved from 0.21 to 0.46
projects.review: the reason codes made our risk committee comfortable

projects.title: Multi-agent research assistant for an equity analyst team
projects.problem: first drafts of company notes took analysts most of a day
projects.approach: planner, researcher and critic agents with a bounded revision loop and source links on every paragraph
outcomes: draft time cut from about 6 hours to 35 minutes
analysts kept 70% of generated paragraphs
projects.review: the critic step is what made the drafts usable

projects.title: Defect detection on a textile production line
projects.problem: manual inspection missed small weaving defects at line speed
projects.approach: an object detector trained on 9k annotated frames and exported to run on edge devices beside each loom
outcomes: defect recall of 0.91 at 25 FPS on the device
customer returns for weaving faults down 27%
projects.review: worked on the factory floor, not just in the demo

projects.title: Chatbot over HR policies with access control
projects.problem: HR answered the same 50 leave and benefits questions every week
projects.approach: a Teams bot that answers from the policy wiki and filters documents by the employee's country and grade
outcomes: HR ticket volume down 41% in three months
no policy answers leaked across regions in the audit
projects.review: employees use it instead of emailing us

projects.title: Recommendation engine for a podcast app
projects.problem: new listeners churned because the home feed showed only the global top 20
projects.approach: matrix-factorisation recommendations with a content-based fallback for cold-start users, served from a Redis cache
outcomes: 7-day listener retention up 9%
home-feed click-through up 22%
projects.review: retention numbers moved, which is what we paid for

projects.title: LLM cost and latency optimisation for a writing tool
projects.problem: monthly LLM spend had tripled and p95 latency was over 9 seconds
projects.approach: semantic caching, routing short requests to a small self-hosted model and tracing every call with token and cost attributes
outcomes: API spend down 58%
p95 latency from 9.4 s to 2.1 s
projects.review: paid for itself in the first month

projects.title: Named-entity extraction for Urdu news articles
projects.problem: no off-the-shelf model recognised people and places in Urdu news reliably
projects.approach: fine-tuned a multilingual transformer on 6k hand-labelled sentences with active learning to pick what to label next
outcomes: entity F1 of 0.86, up from 0.61 for the multilingual baseline
labelling budget cut by about 40% through active learning
projects.review: understood the language quirks better than we expected

projects.title: Churn prediction and retention playbook for a telecom
projects.problem: the retention team called customers at random and burned their offer budget
projects.approach: a churn model with calibrated probabilities and a simple uplift ranking so offers went to persuadable customers
outcomes: retention campaign ROI up 2.3x
AUC of 0.84 on the next quarter's data
projects.review: clear explanation of which customers to call and why

projects.title: Prompt-injection hardening for a customer-facing agent
projects.problem: a booking agent could be talked into issuing refunds by instructions hidden in emails
projects.approach: untrusted-content delimiting, tool permission tiers, a red-team suite of 150 attacks and PII masking in logs
outcomes: attack success rate fell from 34% to 3% on the red-team suite
no PII in traces after the rollout audit
projects.review: they broke our agent first, then fixed it

projects.title: Medical-image triage prototype for chest X-rays
projects.problem: radiologists needed urgent studies pushed to the top of the reading list
projects.approach: a DenseNet classifier with Grad-CAM heatmaps that reorders the worklist; never used for diagnosis
outcomes: sensitivity 0.92 for urgent findings on the retrospective set
time-to-read for urgent cases down 31% in the pilot
projects.review: careful about what the model should and should not decide

projects.title: Data-labelling tool with model-assisted pre-annotation
projects.problem: annotators labelled every image from scratch
projects.approach: a Label Studio backend that pre-annotates with the latest model and routes uncertain items to senior annotators
outcomes: labelling throughput up 2.6x
inter-annotator disagreement down 18%
projects.review: our annotators noticed the speed-up on day one
